promptingStudio.scene: A soundproofed astronomical observatory library at midnight. Expansive, velvety acoustic space with intimate proximity and deep atmospheric silence.
promptingStudio.sampleContext: Mysterious, awe-inspiring, and contemplative. Tone is deep baritone, whisper-soft, measured, and hypnotic with generous pauses between cosmic revelations.
promptingStudio.sampleSpeechBlock: Out beyond the quiet orbits of Neptune and the Kuiper Belt, the universe unfolds into vast, silent emptiness. Light from ancient stars has traveled across billions of years, just to meet our eyes in this quiet moment. We are not merely observing the cosmos; we are the universe observing itself.
promptingStudio.combinedPromptTemplate:
Scene: A soundproofed astronomical observatory library at midnight. Expansive, velvety acoustic space with intimate proximity and deep atmospheric silence.
Sample Context: Mysterious, awe-inspiring, and contemplative. Tone is deep baritone, whisper-soft, measured, and hypnotic with generous pauses between cosmic revelations.

Speaker 1 - Deep Cosmic Narrator (George / Charon):
Out beyond the quiet orbits of Neptune and the Kuiper Belt, the universe unfolds into vast, silent emptiness. Light from ancient stars has traveled across billions of years, just to meet our eyes in this quiet moment. We are not merely observing the cosmos; we are the universe observing itself.

elevenlabsCloningConfiguration.voiceDesignPrompt: A deep, baritone male British narrator with a calm, hypnotic, and awe-inspiring tone. Slow-paced, cinematic, and soothing, perfect for space documentaries and sleep science.
elevenlabsCloningConfiguration.dubbingProductionSOP: Đặt micro gần miệng (proximity effect) để tăng độ trầm ấm của âm trầm, kết hợp nhạc nền ambient không gian vũ trụ âm lượng -24dB phía dưới.
